train_meta_cfr_agent: train a meta-cfr agent using MetaCFRRegretAgent with specified game name, model type, and perturbation settings
evaluate_meta_cfr_agent: evaluate a trained meta-cfr agent using CFRBREvaluation against a perturbed WorldState
compute_cfr_values: compute CFR values for a game tree over a specified number of training epochs
compute_cfr_plus_values: compute CFR-plus values for a game tree over a specified number of training epochs
build_game_tree: build a game tree from a WorldState for a given game with perturbation and random seed
